summary: Creates and controls GPU particle simulations. Particles are POP points with attributes such as P, PartVel, PartMass, PartLifeSpan, PartDrag, and PartForce, usually maintained through a feedback-style POP loop.

key_params.name: targetpop
key_params.note: Downstream feedback-loop POP that supplies previous-frame state

key_params.name: initializepulse
key_params.note: Initialize the simulation state before starting

key_concepts: particle attributes PartId, P, PartVel, PartAge, and PartLifeSpan
PartForce, PartMass, PartDrag, and PartDeath attributes
Time Integration from force to velocity to position
input point attribute transfer and renaming
common_gotchas: A real Particle POP system needs a valid target feedback-loop POP; a lone Particle POP is not a complete simulation.
Force and motion often flow through PartForce and PartVel attributes, so inspect those attributes when debugging.
Use Initialize/Start discipline and Info channels rather than assuming the first frame is ready.
